subject: Next steps: Finlytics evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@finlytics.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Finlytics evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive

Hi Taylor / Sam 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're all aligned:

- Primary use case: semantic search over customer support tickets + automated summaries for escalations.
- Key success metrics you mentioned: embedding recall > 0.85 on core prompt set, generation latency p95 < 250ms, and cost target ~ $0.03/1k tokens.
- Data sensitivity: some PII in tickets; want private deployment options for regulated flows.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff + technical deep-dive where we'll:
1) Walk through the 2-week trial plan I've attached (finlytics-trial-plan-connor-v1.pdf).
2) Align on success criteria and prompt/eval sets (stub attached: redwood-eval-prompt-set.csv).
3) Identify required participants from your side (Dev, CTO, Security).
4) Confirm timelines and Redwood deliverables (model variants, quantization profile recommendations, and dashboard access).

Available slots next week (PT):
- Wed 2026-03-31: 10:00-11:00am
- Thu 2026-04-01: 2:00-3:00pm
- Fri 2026-04-02: 9:00-10:00am

Can you confirm which works best and who from Finlytics should join? I've CC'd Marissa (solutions engineer) who will run the technical portion.

Links: https://drive.google.com/finlytics-eval-plan (trial plan + eval dashboard prep)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: finlytics-trial-plan-connor-v1.pdf, redwood-eval-prompt-set.csv

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@finlytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Finlytics evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive

Connor 

Appreciate the summary and the plan. Sam (CTO) and I spoke 
- please include Sam (sam.patel@finlytics.com) and our security lead Priya Shah (priya@finlytics.com) on the kickoff. We want the technical deep-dive to include:
- Runtime architecture (how caching/batching will affect our SLA)
- Quantization/accuracy tradeoffs and model fallbacks
- Network and data handling (encryption, KMS/HSM options)

Of the slots you proposed, Wed 2026-03-31 10:00am PT looks best for our team. Can you send a calendar invite and include a short agenda? Also confirm what you need from us ahead of time 

Thanks,
Taylor
Head of Product, Finlytics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@finlytics.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@finlytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Finlytics evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive

Perfect 

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping in the right folks. Wed 2026-03-31 10:00am PT is confirmed on our side. I'll send a calendar invite in the next 10 minutes; invite will include a Google Meet link and the Drive folder we'll use for artifacts.

Agenda (60m):
- 5m: Introductions & goals
- 15m: Trial plan walkthrough (deliverables & timeline)
- 25m: Technical deep-dive (runtime architecture, latency expectations, quantization options, security controls) - Marissa will lead
- 10m: Success criteria & next steps (metrics, access, data prep)

What we need from you before the call:
- Representative prompt set (CSV) + example ticket snippets (anonymized) 

- List of internal stakeholders who should get access to the eval dashboard.
- Any must-have security/compliance requirements (SOC2 controls, data residency).

Attachments: finlytics-trial-plan-connor-v1.pdf (trial plan), redwood-eval-prompt-set.csv (prompt stub)
HubSpot deal: FIN-2026-0423

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0132

Subject: Re: Next steps: Finlytics evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive

Confirmed 

I just sent a calendar invite for Wed 2026-03-31 10:00am PT and added Sam, Priya, and our engineering lead. I'll upload the representative prompts and a small anonymized sample of tickets to the Drive folder by EOD Monday.

Looking forward to the call.

Taylor
Head of Product, Finlytics
